div.l: With hym ther was his sone / aȝong squier
A louier a lusty bacheler
Wit lokkes crulle / as they were leyde in presse
Of xxᵗⁱ . ȝere of age / was he as I gesse
Of his stature / he was of Euene lengthe
And wonderly deliuer / and greet of strengthe
And he had ben somtyme / in Chiuachie
In Flaundres in Artoys / and in Picardie
And born hym wel / as of so litel space
In hope to stonden / in his lady grace
Enbrowded was he / as it were a mede
All ful of fresshe / floures white and rede
Syngynge he was . / or flowtynge al the day
He was as fressh / as is the monthe of May
Short was his gowne / with sleues longe and wyde
Wel cowde he sitte on hors / and fayre ryde
He cowde songes make / and wel endite
Iuste and eek daunce / and wel portreye and write
So hote he loued / that by nyghter tale
He slepte no more / than doth a nyghtyngale
Curteys he was / lowely and seruisable
And carf bifore / his fader atte table
A yeman hadde he / and seruᵃauntes no mo
At that tyme / for hym lust ride so
And he was clad / in coote and hood of grene
A sheef of pecok arwes / brighte and kene
Vnder his belte / he bar ful thriftily
Wel cowde he dresse / his takel ȝomanly
His arwes drouped / nought with fotheres lowe
And in his hand / he bar a mighty bowe
A not heed had he / with a broıı̄un visage
Of wode craft / wel cowde he al the vsage
Vp on his arme / he bar a gay bracer
And by his side / a swerd and a bokeler
And on that other side / a gay daggere
Harneysed wel / and sharp as poynt of spere
A xpofre on his brest / of siluer shene
An horn he bar / the bawdrik was of grene
A foster was he / sothely as I gesse.
